title: Ruthless Bar Salts Red Skitz Skitz 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Red Skitz Skitz delivers a lively burst of fruity confectionary flavour, recreating the unmistakable taste of classic red berry sweets. Bright notes of Strawberries and Cherries blend seamlessly with a hint of citrus, creating a tangy-sweet medley that lingers with every puff. The result is a playful and intensely flavourful vape that captures the essence of chewy, fruit-flavoured treats. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid is formulated for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, delivering a smooth balance of flavour and vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a comfortable throat hit and fast nicotine absorption, making it an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy nostalgic, sweet-inspired blends. Ruthless has long been at the forefront of the vaping industry, crafting bold and innovative e-liquids that set new flavour benchmarks. Their expertly blended shortfills and nic salts continue to offer vapers a premium experience with every bottle.
